named-query.name: Expedicao.listarPorPeriodoESituacao
named-query.query: select e.codigo, e.titulo, c.nome, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.situacao from Expedicao e join e.caverna c where e.inicioPrevisto between :inicio and :fim and e.situacao = :situacao order by e.inicioPrevisto, e.codigo

named-query.name: Expedicao.buscarDetalhesSemBinarios
named-query.query: select e.codigo, e.titulo, e.objetivo, c.nome, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.orcamentoAprovado, e.custoRealizado, e.maxParticipantes, e.situacao, e.cancelamentoEmergencial from Expedicao e join e.caverna c where e.id = :expedicaoId

named-query.name: Participacao.listarPorExpedicaoComPessoa
named-query.query: select p from Participacao p join fetch p.pessoa where p.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId order by p.pessoa.nome

named-query.name: Coleta.listarPorExpedicao
named-query.query: select c from Coleta c join fetch c.setor join fetch c.pesquisador where c.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId order by c.dataHora

named-query.name: Amostra.listarPorColeta
named-query.query: select a.id, a.codigoCampo, a.categoria, a.quantidade, a.unidade, a.dataAcondicionamento, a.condicaoConservacao, a.materialPerigoso, a.observacoes from Amostra a where a.coleta.id = :coletaId order by a.codigoCampo

named-query.name: Equipamento.listarDisponiveisPorPeriodo
named-query.query: select e from Equipamento e where e.situacao = turmalina.pweb3.model.enums.SituacaoOperacionalEquipamento.DISPONIVEL and not exists ( select m.id from MovimentacaoEquipamento m where m.equipamento = e and m.retiradaEm < :fim and (m.devolucaoEfetiva is null or m.devolucaoEfetiva > :inicio) ) order by e.nome, e.codigoPatrimonial

named-query.name: PlanoSeguranca.baixarMapaPorExpedicao
named-query.query: select p.mapaRota from PlanoSeguranca p where p.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId

named-query.name: AutorizacaoAmbiental.baixarArquivoPorExpedicao
named-query.query: select a.arquivoPdf from AutorizacaoAmbiental a where a.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId

named-query.name: RelatorioFinal.baixarArquivoPorExpedicao
named-query.query: select r.arquivoCompleto from RelatorioFinal r where r.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId
